brief: The canvas displays an intricate, tessellating lattice composed of interlocking hexagons. These shapes are in perpetual motion, rotating and shifting to create dynamic, mesmerizing patterns. The network appears constantly fluid until localized areas suddenly break their geometric integrity, fracturing momentarily before reforming and settling back into the interconnected lattice. The visual effect is a continuous, fragile network of constantly shifting shapes.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing lattice of interlocking hexagons in perpetual motion. Each hexagon rotates and shifts subtly over time, creating an ever-changing pattern that feels both geometrically precise and fluidly organic. The network maintains its integrity while periodically fracturing—each hexagon momentarily breaks its form before reforming—creating a sense of fragile, living structure. The visual rhythm combines steady, hypnotic motion with sudden bursts of disruption, evoking the tension between order and chaos in dynamic systems.
